editorial:
Imagine feeling like your life has just stopped moving. You are stuck in the same boring routine every single day, and nothing feels exciting anymore. That is exactly where you find these four high school teachers. They are tired, burnt out, and feel like they have lost their spark. To fix this, they decide to try a wild experiment. They read a theory that says if you keep a steady amount of alcohol in your blood at all times, you will actually be happier and more successful. It sounds crazy, but you get to watch them go from being miserable to feeling alive again as they drink through their workdays.

The acting is the best part here because the chemistry between the friends feels totally real. You will laugh at the chaos, but you will also feel for them when things start to fall apart. The movie moves at a great pace and keeps you guessing if the plan will actually work. If you want the best experience, you should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video or rent it on Apple TV to see all the great detail. It is a perfect pick for anyone who feels stuck in a rut and needs a reminder to enjoy life.
endingExplained: Things take a dark turn when one friend struggles to stop drinking and loses everything. However, the main character finds his joy again. In the final scene, he goes to a party and dances with a huge smile on his face. He is not drinking to hide his pain anymore; he is just happy to be alive. He lets go of his stress and chooses to embrace the chaos of life, ending the movie on a high note.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about friendship and finding yourself.
